Oracle Systems (NYSE:ORCL) Sentiment Report
November 14, 2018 - By Louis Casey Sentiment for Oracle Systems (NYSE:ORCL)
Oracle Systems (NYSE:ORCL) institutional sentiment decreased to 0.82 in Q2 2018 . Its down -0.05, from 0.87 in 2018Q1. The ratio has dropped, as 521 investment managers increased or started new holdings, while 637 decreased and sold positions in Oracle Systems. The investment managers in our partner’s database now have: 2.13 billion shares, down from 2.24 billion shares in 2018Q1. Also, the number of investment managers holding Oracle Systems in their top 10 holdings decreased from 63 to 57 for a decrease of 6. Sold All: 73 Reduced: 564 Increased: 414 New Position: 107.
Oracle Corporation develops, manufactures, markets, sells, hosts, and supports application, platform, and infrastructure technologies for information technology environments worldwide. The company has market cap of $185.04 billion. It provides services in three primary layers of the cloud: Software as a Service, Platform as a Service, and Infrastructure as a Service. It has a 51.52 P/E ratio. The firm licenses its Oracle Database software, which enables storage, retrieval, and manipulation of data; and Oracle Fusion Middleware software to build, deploy, secure, access, and integrate business applications, as well as automate their business processes.
The stock decreased 1.35% or $0.67 during the last trading session, reaching $48.84. About 15.84M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has declined 6.50% since November 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.12% the S&P500.
Analysts await Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) to report earnings on December, 13. They expect $0.70 earnings per share, up 12.90 % or $0.08 from last year’s $0.62 per share. ORCL’s profit will be $2.65B for 17.44 P/E if the $0.70 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.62 actual earnings per share reported by Oracle Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 12.90 % EPS growth.
Caledonia Investments Plc holds 10.32% of its portfolio in Oracle Corporation for 862,500 shares. Black Creek Investment Management Inc. owns 6.51 million shares or 8.74% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Vulcan Value Partners Llc has 8.53% invested in the company for 25.02 million shares. The Texas-based Yacktman Asset Management Lp has invested 7.72% in the stock.
